minutes.headline: Parks Commission backed an ADA playground grant application and set a June 25 meeting; the beach house floor moves ahead.
minutes.summary: The commission heard facilities and recreation reports (beach house flooring, summer programs, staffing, chairs), then updates on the dog park, skate park insurance, four grant applications and the OPM contract. It voted to submit an ADA grant application, approved two sets of minutes, and settled on a tentative date for the next meeting because the usual one falls on a holiday.

public_comment.topic: A resident (address given as 56 ... Street, apparently a historical commission member) reported that the Marshall Park caves are outside the phase one work area, that the historical commission received a grant for a town-wide historical inventory including Marshall Park, and that a 3D rendering of the underground complex may be donated. Cautioned that the softball field and playground could affect the area.

votes.motion: Approve submitting the ADA grant application for the amount stated
Accept the minutes of January 17, 2024 and March 20, 2024 with the correction to Anita's last name

budget_items.what_was_said: The plywood subfloor price came in lower than the first Home Depot-based estimate after a better quote from a supplier.
Chairs are currently rented per program; a member offered donated chairs and purchase depends on budget left at season end.
A park grant was awarded, starting July 1.

budget_items.topic: Land and Water Conservation Fund grant
budget_items.what_was_said: Town was selected but the grant is not yet awarded; the funder wants an Army Corps of Engineers wetlands permit determination first.
No word has been received on the trails grant.

budget_items.topic: ADA grant / Marshall Park playground estimates
budget_items.what_was_said: The playground estimate rose between the original and January estimates, mainly from poured-rubber surfacing and equipment; the grant ask is the difference.
Motion to submit the ADA grant application.
Application pending for weed and debris removal at Marshall and the town beach; no word yet.
The town manager reached agreement on a first-year contract with a not-to-exceed value to cover phase one.
Several summer programs are below their minimum registrations needed to run.

decisions.decision: Commission agreed to put up the Memorial Day flags at Veterans Park regardless of whether a ceremony is held.
Dog park at the former t-ball field: chair to check insurance with the town manager and return to it next meeting; dog policy needs updating.
Agreed to apply for the larger ADA grant amount covering the surface and the two smaller equipment pieces, as one project.
Chair to keep following up on the Lake Shirley parcels agreement with the select board.
Next meeting tentatively set for Tuesday June 25, to be confirmed with Chris and Anna; June 19 is a holiday.
Angela to send the summer program schedule so members can volunteer to cover dates.

what_happened.line: The commission voted to submit an ADA grant application, covering the playground surface and two smaller equipment pieces as one project; the amount was not audible.
It agreed to apply for the larger ADA grant amount, treating the surface and the two equipment pieces as a single project.
The Dog park at the former t-ball field was carried over: the chair will check insurance with the town manager and return next meeting.
The commission was told a park grant was awarded, and that a Land and Water Conservation Fund grant is not yet awarded pending a wetlands permit determination.
The next meeting was tentatively set for Tuesday, June 25, because June 19 is a holiday.

why_it_matters: The ADA grant would help pay for accessible changes to the Marshall Park playground, whose cost estimate rose between the original and January versions, so the town's own share depends on whether the grant is awarded.
Several grants are still undecided (Land and Water Conservation Fund, trails, dredging), and a dog park on the t-ball field cannot move ahead until the insurance question is answered.
watch_next: Parks Commission meeting tentatively set for Tuesday, June 25, to be confirmed.
The chair's insurance check with the town manager on the dog park, due back at the next meeting.
